answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because reef only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, summit is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any terrace approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
